measurement_policy.environment: Release arm64, coverage/sanitizer off; same host, performance and stress runs serial
measurement_policy.measurement_start: Each scenario defines its own boundary; CPU windows and command submission must not be labelled presentation.
measurement_policy.measurement_end: CPU uses first/last valid process counter samples; GUI readiness/completion needs separate observed receipts.
measurement_policy.ui_observation: backend, scenario, resource_count, and visibility are caller observations and remain unverified unless separate GUI evidence exists
measurement_policy.budget_status: proposed; absolute user-operation budgets remain null
